{{Quote|I am Sergeant Wallax of the Imperial Navy. You are commanded to hand over all of your weapons and gear immediately.|Wallax, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="Musty" />}}
'''Wallax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Since when does the Imperial Navy take its orders from Mandalorians?|The [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]], to Wallax|<ref name="Musty" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> the corrupt sergeant was hired by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tarro Blood]] to arrest a [[Hunter (individual)|rival bounty hunter]], and Wallax and a squad of his men intercepted the hunter in the [[Nexus Room]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Kaas City]], the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. However, when Blood contacted Wallax during the "arrest" to confirm his success, Wallax's men grew suspicious of their commander's intentions and demanded in on the pay. Nonetheless, the bounty hunter killed Wallax and all of his men.<ref name="Musty" />
